kilns:Brick kilns — 13 here:22.6415,88.9.desc: 13 brick kilns annotated in this satellite tile. The position is the tile’s own reference point — the dataset records kilns as annotated boxes inside a satellite tile rather than as individual coordinates, so this locates them to within about a kilometre, not to a chimney. Detected from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and hand-validated, from SentinelKilnDB — 62,671 kilns across the Indo-Gangetic Plain covering India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Afghanistan.
